what: /  SVG strokes (hand scribble·underline·zigzag scratch) are drawn from start to end when visible — default is 1.6s in one smooth pass, data-fx-stroke-draw="steps: 7" With steps like this, it runs in a stair-stepped .42s, scraping along in turn at .12s each

options.steps: Step count — adds scratches when set (e.g. 7, length .42)
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name (none · slow(0.7,0.7,false)) or ”0.33,1,0.68,1” form, default power2.inOut (steps for stepped)
options.fade: During the first portion (0~1) of the drawn length the line fades in from transparent, default 0 (off) — street-illustration-fintech-landing number circle .8

use: <svg data-fx="stroke-draw" data-fx-stroke-draw="steps: 7" viewBox="0 0 100 40"><path d="…" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"/></svg>
